questions.question: Describe how melody writing are used in a piece of music you have studied. Use musical vocabulary.
questions.correctAnswer: A detailed description using precise musical vocabulary (e.g. specific terms from the AQA elements list), referencing a named piece with accurate observations about how the elements are used and their effect.

questions.question: Compare how two different pieces use melody writing. Explain the effect in each case.
questions.correctAnswer: A comparison of two pieces identifying similarities and differences in how melody writing are used, explaining the different effects created in each musical context, using comparative language.

questions.question: How could you use melody writing in your own composition or performance? Explain your choices.
questions.correctAnswer: A practical application showing understanding of how melody writing can be manipulated in composition or performance, with specific examples of choices made and their intended effect.

questions.correctAnswer: A grade 9 response will: show balanced phrase structure; use at least two development techniques; match melodic style to genre; notate accurately in staff notation; annotate with precise musical vocabulary; explain how melodic choices create the intended character. Mark scheme: AO3 (analyse and evaluate) + AO4 (knowledge and understanding) = total marks for listening; AO1 (perform) + AO2 (compose) for coursework components
questions.explanation: Extended answer: aim for the mark-scheme points, in order, with the command word addressed.
